plan.summary: BRO-7092: finish BRO-5420 g1/g2. Eight London reviews still sit on Broadway shows; their moves to the West End production were refused (same-url-exists) because the West End show already has the same URL on file under another file name. Delete the Broadway-side copy so the London review counts only on the West End production.
